question: What kind of meditation-bath is the speaker about to declare as supreme?
premises: The speaker announces a teaching about dhyānasnāna.
The teaching is said to be supreme.
The statement is introduced by then and also.
inference: The verse introduces a supreme meditation-bath that will be explained next.
uncertainties: The referent of dvābhyām is not explicit from this verse alone.
plain_english: Then I will speak of the meditation-bath, which is also supreme.
